question.worked_solution:
The formula for the derivative of the inverse hyperbolic cotangent function is

$$
\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{arcoth}⁡x)=\frac{1}{1-{x}^{2}}.
$$

Using the formula above with the chain rule, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}[2\operatorname{arcoth}⁡(-x)] \\  & =\frac{2}{1-(-x)^{2}}\cdot (-x)^{′} \\  & =\frac{2}{1-{x}^{2}}\cdot (-1) \\  & =\frac{2}{{x}^{2}-1}.\end{aligned}
$$
